notes.title: 🚨 New game Out of Bounds is NOW AVAILABLE! 🚨
notes.content:
[b]Hello, everybody! How have you been?[/b]

We're doing PRETTY WELL! Closing this crazy 2022 celebrating 🥳

And that's not only because [url=https://edition.cnn.com/2022/12/20/sport/argentina-football-team-arrival-intl-hnk-spt]our football team won the World Cup[/url], but also because we have just released a new game on Steam:

[url=https://youtu.be/U7Q1M-wRbMg][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/53ceb798e992c68ae96c207c36012d92b474fc5d.png[/img][/url]

Out of Bounds is a peculiar title that was originally created for a game jam the past year ([url=https://itch.io/jam/2021-epic-megajam]Epic Megajam 2021[/url]). As a solo dev, I had 7 days to create a game that was later [url=https://tobiasrusjan.itch.io/out-of-bounds]released for free on Itchio[/url].

Since I liked the result of the jam, I decided to keep working on that idea for the next months and also some great devs (former colleagues from other projects) joined me to get the best results in visuals ([url=https://twitter.com/viktorahmed]Viktor Ahmed[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/scuzzostuff/]Claudio "Scuzzo" Sagrera[/url]) and audio ([url=https://twitter.com/davyd_music]David Levill[/url]) 🙌



[h1]THE GAME[/h1]

Out of Bounds is a title about "creating" a game and "fixing" bugs... Yeah, it's crazy. You will pickup blueprints, compile shaders, test sound effects, drink a lot of coffee. But watch out for the bugs! Grab your Line Tracer and get rid of them 👾

https://youtu.be/U7Q1M-wRbMg
Things are starting to get better here in Saibot Studios and Out of Bounds is part of that process. I'm looking forward to bring you news about bigger projects in the future, but for now give a chance to this crazy puzzle shooter with humor and puzzles 🤓

You can follow Out of Bounds on its new Twitter account:
https://twitter.com/OutOfBoundsVg



[h1]NEWS ABOUT EXPLOSIONS AND GORE?[/h1]

Hell yeah! The people at [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/]Humble Bundle[/url] created [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/games/holiday-encore-best-boomer-shooters-bundle]a new package of retro style first person shooters[/url] based on the one they did in March of this year 🔥

[url=https://www.humblebundle.com/games/holiday-encore-best-boomer-shooters-bundle][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/d71afde69b8306dbbb108c8e6fbcb9e42f3a60d0.png[/img][/url]

This time, you can get 7 awesome titles for only 12 dollars, including our own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/753590/Hellbound/]Hellbound[/url] and the great [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1590910/Forgive_Me_Father/]Forgive Me Father[/url] was also added to the list.

A percentage of the sales will go to charity at [url=https://ablegamers.org/]Able Gamers[/url] and [url=https://www.starlight.org/]Starlight Children's Foundation[/url] ❤️

Hurry up! Get the bundle before the next 24 hours ⏲️



If you have a Twitter account, don't forget to follow us for more news:
https://twitter.com/SaibotStudios

Cheers and take care!

[url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan][i]Tobías[/i][/url]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1.3b 🔥
notes.content:
HELLo again, warriors! How are you? How's your weekend so far? ːhellonː

The other day I did a quick fix for some crashes reported by many of you after the last update v1.1.3.

Thanks a lot for the feedback and I wish I could have fixed that before, I've been crazy busy with some personal stuff.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2533295823][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31193015/a2258e2b3b53f6af3a0365c07ab9d37a61bfcb86.jpg[/img][/url]
[list]
[*] [i]Screenshot by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/BFG-12000]BFG-12000[/url][/i]
[/list]
On the other hand, there're some cases were the game freezes during the loading screen because you're trying to load a saved game from an old version (v1.1.2 or earlier). If this is happening to you, I need you to send me your save files via email. To locate those files, just copy-paste-enter the next line into your Windows Explorer: [b]%localappdata%\Hellbound\Saved\SaveGames[/b]

Send me the most recent files you see there (or just all of them), I will check them and then send you back the ones fixed. Email: [b][url=contact@hellboundgame.com]contact@hellboundgame.com[/url][/b]


And to finish the week, here are some AMAZING shots made by a gamer from Steam by the name of [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/BFG-12000]BFG-12000[/url][/b] 🙌

Click on the images to see the originals in high definition, and [url=https://twitter.com/BFG12000]let's follow the guy and his outstanding work at his new Twitter account[/url]. Besides Hellbound, he takes great shoots from other games as well.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2235648852][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31193015/78c02a5a97e72e65c9a11a680be174808902aab5.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2234143623][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31193015/e1942e1beab3299337e478bd03bc0332b356d187.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2527748797][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31193015/b7e01c64ef555c5284c4c8c53bbc0baa5b91a50a.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Build update v1.1.3 ⚙️
notes.content:
An update on a Wednesday afternoon? Hell yeah!

How are you, demonic creatures from the depths of Hell! ? 😈


During the last months we have been working with our friends at 3ogs (Pablo and Mauricio Navajas) and with our talented art director Viktor Ahmed, to bring you that thing you've been asking for a long time...

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/753590/achievements][b]STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS![/b][/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/753590/achievements][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31193015/836c01528b870b7143edfef12b01e861416f4264.jpg[/img][/url]


I also recreated the language system entirely, and added (finally) our own natal-Argentinian Spanish option. And a bunch of other fixes and improvements have been made to the game. Check out the entire list on the bottom of this post 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31193015/277c7450886c72224644c827286778db68ded6d3.jpg[/img]


I want to take this opportunity to share with you our last Kickstarter update, where I did a recap about all the things we have accomplished together during the last years: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tobiasrusjan/hellbound-a-90s-first-person-shooter-made-20-years/posts/3213425][b]Don't miss it, here's the link![/b][/url]

As I mentioned in that post, I want to start working on a new project next month.

Hellbound has been without a doubt an incredible journey for us at Saibot Studios. But unfortunately, we haven't seen a single sale from it, since the third party investment was never recouped. So this right here is probably our last update, or at least for now.


You can follow us on our social networks to stay in touch with us and to keep updated on new things to come: [url=https://twitter.com/HellboundGame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/HellboundGame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/saibotstudios/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCa29sOnJRNG-ZLGU2GfNNow]You Tube[/url].


Once again, I want to thank you all who have been supporting us during this time. This has been a wonderful era in our careers, with a ton of anecdotes and experiences to share ✊

And now... Let's get those freaking achievements unlocked!

[url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan][i]Tobías[/i][/url]

----


CHANGELOG HELLBOUND v1.1.3


[u]New features:[/u]
[list]
[*] Achievement system
[*] Spanish language option added for all texts, including in-game and interfaces
[*] Steam Cloud added for saved games, progress and input settings
[/list]
[u]Bug fixes:[/u]
[list]
[*] Input configuration resets every time you reopen the game
[*] Video quality preset sometimes appears empty and doesn't work properly
[*] In configuration pages the scroll menus and the focused option reset everytime the unsaved-changes-window appears
[*] Sometimes enemies die or crash the game when a door closes above them (thank you Franco Venica for the report)
[*] Pygon enemies appear freezed after specific saved game
[*] Pygon enemies keep attacking after you die
[*] Green light at catacombs entrance turns off after loading a saved game on campaign level 3 The Heroes' Cemetery
[*] Colliseum side doors can be open manually in campaign level 3 The Heroes' Cemetery
[*] When falling down the final sector of campaign level 4 Dead Forest, screen fades black but have to wait several minutos to die
[*] Top switch for main elevator can only be used once at campaign level 5 Flying Souls
[*] Clipping floors on the sides of the survival arena at campaign level 6 City of Fury
[*] Color lights from exit door turning off after loading a saved game at campaign level 6 City of Fury
[*] Sometimes after finishing the survival arena of campaign level 6 City of Fury, the final door doesn't open
[*] The ending text sometimes doesn't finish to show entirely before the screen fades to black
[*] Grotesque quality for textures is showing Low quality textures for some graphic cards
[*] First time you reset the video settings, gamma goes down to 0
[*] After finishing the campaign, the camera changes the field of view (zooms in) affecting the entire game until restart
[*] Voices, Power Up pickups and cinematic sound effects are not affected by the SFX Volume from audio settings
[*] Ferlord is not being able to attack when the player is between his legs
[/list]
[u]General improvements:[/u]
[list]
[*] Item Ammo Pack now gives you +20 Slugs, +6 Shells, +40 Bullets and +4 Rockets (same as individual ammo boxes combined)
[*] Added "All clear" message after finishing a survival arena from the campaign
[*] Multiple spawns at the same time during survivals are now well distributed in different locations
[*] Input keys updated on screen messages Loading Screens and Interactions based on the current configuration settings
[*] Video settings reorganized, simplified, and only working when applied
[*] Little tweaks and fixes over menues and interface: Correct difficulty name on Load Game screen, Secret Discovered pop-up empty offsets on the sides, updated Quit Screen for demons
[*] Smooth disapparition added to chunks of useless weapons, exploding fruits (pumpkins) and container fruits (green onions)
[*] Credits margins fixed and finishing properly on different screen resolutions
[*] Damage area of Rocket Launcher's projectiles increased from 200-800 to 500-1000
[*] Ferlord's energy projectiles slowered down in speed (50%), but increased in size (150%)
[/list]

notes.title: Build update v1.1.2 ⚙️
notes.content:
Warriors from the Underworld! How have you been?

As I mentioned you in the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4XNlS8nNaNQ]2020 recap video[/url], during the first months of this 2021 I have been dedicating most of my time to build the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tobiasrusjan/hellbound-a-90s-first-person-shooter-made-20-years/posts/3148618]physical rewards we promised from our Kickstarter[/url].

But even so, I managed to continue working on fixes and improvements for the game. Among other stuff, the game now has...

[list]
[*] Full Controller Support with keybindings and configuration settings 🎮
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31193015/4272801faacb323b6f6196ccf93a9b63cd504e92.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Loading background images for tally screens on mission replays:
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31193015/97a86e39f84af6bb74109e6b7a73f82452b8458d.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Configuration menus recreated and improved in their navigation:
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31193015/9faca26bde702b230bd0d6ecab121581e2aa5415.png[/img]

[list]
[*] The artbook from Mayhem Pack (DLC) with new pages and definition:
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31193015/70e620ae08634d7641112f20d1c07d31d34e732e.png[/img]


And many other things, from bug fixes to general adjustments, you can see in the list from below 👇

Hoping to have more news soon. Cheers from Saibot Studios!


[i]Tobías Rusjan[/i]


-


CHANGELOG HELLBOUND v1.1.2

New Features:
[list]
[*]Full controller support with keybindings and configuration settings: separated x-y sensitivity; toogles for invert look, vibration and move states by holding down keys
[/list]
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*]Pygon enemies sometimes freeze after loading a saved game or after spawning
[*]Missing secondary bindings for Next Weapon, Previous Weapon and Switch POV Side (now [Q] key as default)
[*]Interval text "Entering Ground Zero" removed after finishing campaign
[*]Entering back and forth between campaign replays and survival arenas used to remove levels from the lists
[*]Total ammo of weapons Indolora and Rocket Launcher was showing only one at a time in HUD
[*]Country flags were not showing after finishing a campaign replay or a survival arena
[*]Clipping wall on last switch at campaign level 1 The Resistance
[*]Getting stuck on walls at last room from campaign level 1 The Resistence
[*]Hellgore's statue clipping to catacombs at campaign level 3 The Heroes' Cemetery
[*]Castle door switch not working after closing the door from level 4 Dead Forest
[*]Secret heart item can be reached through closed secret door at campaign level 5 Flying Souls
[*]Secret soul was opening another secret door when pickup at campaign level 5 Flying Souls
[*]Clipping eye on walls inside the theater hallways at campaign level 5 Flying Souls
[*]Loading a checkpoint from the main elevator make bottom enemies disappear at campaign level 7 Endless Hive
[*]Replaying campaign level 8 The Core doesn't allow you to go back to main menu in tally screen
[/list]
Improvements:
[list]
[*]Win screen for campaign replays now shows the cover of each level as background, instead of the roadmap
[*]Quick load key (F9) now shows a confirmation window before loading
[*]Restart Level option added to all in-game menus
[*]Options available from Lose and Win Screens
[*]Menus redone entirely: selecting flow, centered configuration screens, fadings, sound effects
[*]Moving with arrow keys in all menus, including sound effects feedback for every movement
[*]"Survival level unlocked" pop up redone and placed correctly when return to main menu options
[*]Continue option removed after finishing campaign
[*]Added informative text about playing the campaign to unlock stages for survival and campaign (replays)
[*]Survival "stages" are now called "arenas", and now you can also get access to the sub-menu from start
[*]Confirmation windows buttons now work when you release the click/key, instead of instantly touch it
[*]Sound effect concurrency reduced in menus skull-selection to avoid saturation
[*]Total ammo in HUD is now displayed centered, in two columns and shows "----" when there's no ammo left
[*]Tooltips and interact messages with keycodes updated with gamepad buttons
[*]Current level stats now appear on new campaigns after finishing it once, also 100% stats turn green color
[*]"Press fire key" messages changed to "Any key" to allow keyboard and controller inputs
[*]Trying to escape from the death screen using keyboard or gamepad now shows the exit confirmation window
[*]Sliders from configuration settings focused directly for faster changes
[*]Pop-up message added when trying to quick save during campaign survivals
[*]Fixed collision issues in secret stairs at castle from level 4 Dead Forest
[*]Sound effects added to main hall elevator and secret door at campaign level 5 Flying Souls
[*]Avoid climbing to secret from top tunnel at campaign level 5 Flying Souls
[*]Last game checkpoint at campaign level 8 The Core moved before the boss confrontation
[*]Logo back to basics
[/list]
Mayhem Pack (DLC) - Artbook:
[list]
[*]New pages: introduction, level 5 Flying Souls, ending
[*]All pages are now in Ultra Wide resolution at 3440x1440 pixels
[*]Numerations added to most of the pages
[*]A lot of tweaks on different images, like color correction and rescales
[/list]

notes.title: 🔥 Hellbound: Flying Souls Update (v1.1.1) 🔥
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/506333d226fbc95ee57883f6635f105a22a35b8c.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Major Update: Flying Souls (v1.1.1) 🌋[/b][/h1]

HELLo, soldiers of Hell! How have you been?

We’ve been in overdrive preparing things for the end of the year and have some explosive new stuff for you! Are you ready? Check this out!

https://youtu.be/1Jc_yza1upM
Since we released the update in August, at Saibot Studios we have been working non-stop fixing bugs, improving the game in general, and at the same time creating new content. So we bring you...

[list]
[*][b]Flying Souls[/b]: The true new level 5 of the campaign. The most complex and varied scenario of all: with indoor and outdoor confrontations and with the highest amount of secrets: 10 (SPOILER: 3 of which are almost-impossible and combined); and aesthetically SHOCKING: a floating island in the clouds, with two huge rings rotating around it.

[*][b]Pygon[/b]: a completely new enemy that’s different from all the rest. It flies, spits energy balls that deal area damage, and teleports to dodge your attacks. We also added this creature to the next levels, so we recommend re-playing them as well.

[*][b]Ground Zero[/b]: We recreated the classic Survival Mode scenario that we launched back in 2018 in the new version of the game, and we included it both in the original game (optional) and in the campaign. Among many other improvements compared to the classic, the new one has high-quality textures, new and improved 3D models, character ragdolls, bloodstains on the stage, new animations and visual effects for weapons, remastered music, Hellgore character voices, and much more!
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/bff2bb193701adc63fef2e5570d1d716da91a00c.jpg[/img]

Doing all this was an investment that was not in the plans. Our Publisher Nimble Giant supported our development until the August release and we are grateful for that. Although both teams were very proud of the product we achieved, the sales results were not as expected.

We at Saibot then decided to go one step further and invest what little money we had left to continue improving and expanding the game, thus giving Hellbound the closure it deserves. Unfortunately, we are far from the game recouping its investment or for us to see any revenue in sales and thus be able to continue expanding the game even more.

That is why this update that we bring you today is a gift for all of you who have been supporting us, so that you can enjoy even a little more of this crazy project that was so important to us. It won't be as big a gameplay extension as you expected, but this is because our vision (commercially flawed probably) was always focused on making a small, high-quality product in all aspects of the game by adding tons of handcrafted details in each scene, enemy, item, weapon, etc. That was always our main objective; in addition to (of course) invoking the spirit of the classic FPS that we are so passionate about.

Each level of the campaign took us between 3 and 4 months of hard work, with an incredible development team of 6 people (of which only 4 were full time). The levels are built by hand, without any type of pattern or modular objects like tiles. This makes everything look more varied and organic, which was what we wanted; instead of repeated and simple.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/50bf5b35fe32b20ece8bb66d579ebf92350fbdc9.jpg[/img]

We’re taking this update as an opportunity to say goodbye to Saibot's current team as we will not be in a financial position to continue supporting the team until further notice. Next year a new phase will begin for everyone, with new journeys, opportunities and new projects.

Thanks again to everyone who supported us, these past 5 years have been truly AMAZING, we grew SO MUCH and built something GREAT together.


We leave you with screenshots of the new content, we hope you like it as much as we do.

Cheers from the unstoppable team at Saibot Studios!

[i]Tobías Rusjan[/i]


[b][u]Campaign level Flying Souls:[/u][/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/e167343417dfb98a833a9774c96f0e587404736b.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/2f2d27cd0f314aa4fc35721e1b32f599b50cc170.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/a3339760bd904776ba0ff72b7957a3ecbcd66b80.jpg[/img]


[b][u]Survival Mode Remaster level Ground Zero:[/u][/b]

tags.feature: Flying Souls: The true new level 5 of the campaign. The most complex and varied scenario of all: with indoor and outdoor confrontations and with the highest amount of secrets: 10 (SPOILER: 3 of which are almost-impossible and combined); and aesthetically SHOCKING: a floating island in the clouds, with two huge rings rotating around it.

Pygon: a completely new enemy that’s different from all the rest. It flies, spits energy balls that deal area damage, and teleports to dodge your attacks. We also added this creature to the next levels, so we recommend re-playing them as well.

Ground Zero: We recreated the classic Survival Mode scenario that we launched back in 2018 in the new version of the game, and we included it both in the original game (optional) and in the campaign. Among many other improvements compared to the classic, the new one has high-quality textures, new and improved 3D models, character ragdolls, bloodstains on the stage, new animations and visual effects for weapons, remastered music, Hellgore character voices, and much more!

notes.title: Build Update v1.0.3 ⚙️
notes.content:
Warriors from the Underworld! How are you? :zombie:

Today we have a new update for Hellbound (v1.0.3), which includes a lot of fixes and improvements based on your awesome feedback! You can see the entire changelog below 👇

And we want to take this opportunity to thank our friends at [url=https://www.3ogs.com.ar/]3ogs (Pablo and Mauricio Navajas)[/url], who have been helping us fixing most of the bugs here. You guys rock!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31193015/454f2361d5a6b110a7aac7b0396bea080cdb8f82.png[/img]


Among other stuff, we finally finished creating (and adding to the game) the full body statues of our amazing backers from Kickstarter and from our official website 🙌

This is a task we have been doing for the last year and a half. You sent us your idea, we conceptualized it (Fernando Muzzio), then created the final 3D version (by Juan Caratino), and finally added to the game.

All the statues are located inside the level 3 of the campaign: "The Heroes' Cemetery". Some of them are on the surface, others at the coliseum (survival sector), and the rest can only be found in secret rooms...


Hope you guys like it as much as we do. Below you will find some examples :eyes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31193015/8df66588d556b7dd9353dea5f4929b0d57a32b25.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31193015/c2c2f4b5f7cd0d29caecb67f91fe132c4b473d32.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31193015/086db8b28440323c55d7ae08b0c06bee5c9e627d.jpg[/img]


Cheers and have a hell of a weekend!

[i]Tobias Rusjan and the team at Saibot Studios[/i]

-

CHANGELOG HELLBOUND v1.0.3

New Features:
- Quick save (F5) and quick load (F9)
- Show current stats (Kills, Items and Secrets) on the top-right of the screen during missions

Tweaks and Improvements:
- Weapon Simple Shotgun now only shoots by clicking (no more holding down)
- All full body statues of backers created and added to The Heroes' Cemetery
- Winning a separated level from the Campaign now goes to the Tally screen with the scores (instead of returning to the main menu)
- Finishing a separated mission (Levels from Campaign or Stages from Survival) now lets you replay, choose another one, and see rankings
- Death and winning states flow made quicker and more polished
- All visuals and audio from menu-windows improved
- Showing current ranking after ended match (level, difficulty and type)
- Secrets detection tweaked at levels The Resistance, Dead Forest and City of Fury

Bug Fixes:
- FOV resets everytime game reloads
- Save files drastically increased in size in some specific cases, making levels imposible to load
- Rankings from campaign levels were showing incorrect results
- Rankings from survival stages were not showing current player row on the bottom
- Game crashed when picking up first-time-weapons during saved-games on version v1.0.1
- Pressing Escape during interval screens (tally) was blocking the game
- When playing on HELLMARE! you kept loosing health during interval screens
- Sound effect for sand storm at survival stage Fury Road was playing during loading screen

We have been working on fixes and improvements for the game since the release, and today we finally have the first patch in v1.0.2 🤘

notes.title: Common issue in Closed Beta 🦟
notes.content:
Guys! There's a damn bug crashing the Closed Beta. While we fix it, please try this workaround:

- Enter the directory %localappdata%/Hellbound/
- Delete the "Saved" folder

That's the configuration from the Demo version. You wont't need that anymore, so you can delete it to solve the crash.

If the Saved folder is not in that directory, look for it inside the game's folder: Right Click on Hellbound from the Steam Library > Properties > Local Files > Browse Local Files...

Thank you and sorry about that!

- Armor and Health rounding issues fixed
- Fixed a bug that prevented the Doors to make corpses explode upon

- Doors no longer get stuck when an enemy body is underneath them
- Pickups fixed for demo
- Autorun is now off by default
- General main menu fixes:
[list][*]Resetting the values now works 
[*]Changing crosshair now works
[*]Windowed/Fullscreen switch now works
[*]Resolution changes now works
[*]Added confirmation window when pending changes are detected
[*]Secondary input buttons now work
[*]Added more graphical options
[*]Motion blur is now off by default[/list]

notes.title: 🤓 A year of progress 😎
notes.content:
Hi everybody! It’s been awhile, how have you been?

Today a year has passed since the conclusion of our Kickstarter, that’s why we want to make a brief recap about the state of the project 🧐

As you maybe remember, our original goals here were:
[list]
[*]Finish the Survival Mode
[*]Build The Heroes’ Cemetery for all of our backers
[*]Create an entire playable level of the Campaign Mode to convince investors
[/list]

Well, “let's go by parts”, said Hellgore while he was ripping and tearing a poor Vlader…

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31193015/af34e46cd1f6a23507f6632086ad59e629e4725b.jpg[/img]
[i]Viktor (right), Fercho (center) and I (left) during late night working[/i]



[b]THE SURVIVAL MODE[/b]

During past year (2018) we did some adjustments, but the real upgrades will come with the release of the Campaign Mode, since we’re going to make use of all the progress made there.

We can’t add those improvements to the active version of the game at Steam yet, because we’re still working on the internal structure of the engine. But we can tell you that we’re working with the experimented team of programmers at NGD Studios for that, so the game can achieve the best results in performance and porting 👍

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31193015/82eb8289b4ce725205866daa5f6f49615c3e94f0.jpg[/img]
[i]NGD programming team during a master class[/i]



[b]THE HEROES' CEMETERY[/b]

We decided that this place is going to be an entire level of the Campaign Mode, where all the immortalized souls (from Kickstarter and from [url=http://hellboundgame.com/]our website[/url]) rest in Hell forever.

Since our last post on April, we have been organizing all the information given by you guys (names, photos, phrases), and we slowly started designing every headstone, bust and statue. Soon enough, there will be updates on this as well. Here’s a quick spoiler of the cemetery:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31193015/ee0b7304b3792e6bc43133de5cb53e834c29b0d0.jpg[/img]
[i]A quick look of cemetery’s ground[/i]



[b]THE CAMPAIGN MODE[/b]

So here’s where we have been dedicated most of our time, sweat and blood (mostly blood for sure).

As we’ve just mentioned you, we’re working with NGD Studios, who currently our publishers for Hellbound. This is allowing us to create, not only one single level of the campaign, but an entire episode ✌️

Right now 25% of the levels from the game have (almost) final visuals and audio; 50% count with gameplay placements (enemies, items, areas, doors, switches, Etc.); and 100% was already blocked out (”grey boxes”).

Today we have created more than 1000 props with materials and textures; 5 new items; 3 new music soundtracks; 1 new enemy, and more…

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31193015/e9d8271621aad31e94c3df415356f8f0a0a40080.jpg[/img]
[i]Just a few of the many props created for the environments[/i]



We want to reveal final screenshots of the game very soon, but we’re still working on that, and we also need to find a better timing (a day before E3 isn’t the best moment of course).


Thank you for this amazing year! Keep on [url=https://www.facebook.com/HellboundVideogame]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/HellboundGame]Twitter[/url] 👍

Cheers from the team at Saibot Studios!

[i]Tobías Rusjan[/i]
